name: infotabs
description: InfoTabs is a table-question-answering benchmark drawn from the Table-Benchmark suite that measures a model's ability to read structured tabular data and answer factual and inferential questions about it. It contains prompts that require extracting, aggregating, and reasoning over table entries rather than free-form text. The benchmark is intended to evaluate tabular understanding and question-answering capabilities.
reputation: Part of the Table-Benchmark suite and moderately used in the tabular QA research community for evaluating models on table understanding.
